what: _resume_plan precedence is underspecified relative to the Resume starts list
scenario_or_breakage: Merged/postmerge recovery can lose to open-pr: e.g. PHASE=postmerge or PR_CLOSED=true with gh still OPEN matches rule 7 before rule 8, skips postmerge, re-enters CI, and can report OK on the wrong lifecycle
suggested_fix: Document and implement fixed classification order in _resume_plan: blocked-rebase → done (PHASE=done) → merged (rule 8, including PHASE=postmerge/PR_CLOSED/MERGE_RESULT/gh MERGED) → open-pr (rule 7) → fresh; add a test with PHASE=postmerge + OPEN PR asserting start=merged

what: Terminal and cap stall paths still call _write_terminal_state without counter kwargs today; plan extends the helper but does not pin every early-return site
